author: The Current
description:
Bartees Strange describes how the way to solve problems is to face them
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

In an interview with The Current's Nilufer Arsala, Bartees Strange talks about being vulnerable when facing life's problems. "Most of the big things in life, there's really only one way to fix," Strange says, "and it's with being vulnerable and walking right through it, and it's the hardest thing you can ever do."

@bartees_strange' album, "Horror," is available on @4ad_official.

author: The Current
description:
Ratboys performing "Anywhere" live at The Current Microshow in Minneapolis
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Chicago indie-rock band Ratboys performed an intimate MicroShow at Cloudland Theater in Minneapolis on Tuesday, Nov. 18, 2025. The show came not long after the release of the band’s latest single, “Light Night Mountains All That,” which dropped in September — an advance single coming ahead of the band’s next album, Singin’ to an Empty Chair, expected February 6, 2026, on New West Records. Ratboys’ eight-song set at Cloudland included five songs from the forthcoming album.

Concert attendees consisted of lucky winners who entered for a chance to win passes to the show. This Microshow event was supported by @voodoorangerIPA. Watch a performance of "Anywhere" above.

Musicians
Julia Steiner – vocals, guitar
David Sagan – guitar
